content: In-process detail for LDA, defined a corpus (text) as $D={d_{1},d_{2},d_{3},....,d_{M}}$ where M is number of text documents and $d_{M}$ is a number of text documents in the corpus. A document is a series of N words denoted by $W={w_{1},w_{2},w_{3},....,w_{N}}$ , where $w_{N}$ is the $Nth$ word in the sequence of text document.
